_comment: Sandbox trial (2026-08-26): Bash commands run inside bubblewrap with writes confined to this repo, /tmp and the listed caches, and network limited to the listed hosts. Needs `sudo apt-get install socat` on Linux; until then Claude Code warns and runs unsandboxed (failIfUnavailable is off on purpose). New hosts prompt (auto mode: classifier). The dev server is excluded so the browser can reach it. Unsandboxed retries run silently (no ask rule; the user accepts ~98% of prompts). Known tooling friction: tsx opens a Unix-domain IPC socket the sandbox blocks, so the tsx-backed npm scripts and npx tsx are in excludedCommands and run unsandboxed; memory writes under ~/.claude retry unsandboxed too (protected path).
